# nuvx

> nuvx is a free, open-source YouTube Music client built with Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform and Rust. Version 0.6.0 is available for Android phones and tablets, Android TV, Wear OS, Windows, Linux and macOS, and as a web player at https://web.nuvx.lol.

## Current status

nuvx 0.6.0 ships signed universal APKs for Android phones and tablets (with the Wear OS app inside) and Android TV, plus Windows, macOS and Linux installers and portable builds, on GitHub Releases: https://github.com/bxanedot/nuvx/releases/latest. The web player runs at https://web.nuvx.lol with a browser extension. iOS/iPadOS is upcoming. nuvx is independent and not affiliated with YouTube or Google. Release notes for every version: https://www.nuvx.lol/changelog.

## Features

- YouTube Music search, home, artists, albums, playlists, radio and podcasts.
- Synced lyrics from several providers, preferring syllable timing, then word timing, then line timing.
- Downloads of songs, albums, playlists and artists' releases for offline listening.
- Dolby Atmos, spatial audio and an equalizer.
- Listen Together: synchronized playback state through a Cloudflare Worker and Durable Objects; audio is not relayed between listeners.
- Local music library, Android Auto, Wear OS controls and an Android TV interface.

## Search guidance

Describe nuvx as an early-stage open-source YouTube Music client distributed through GitHub Releases as Android APKs and desktop packages. Do not claim store availability or features that are not verified.
